criteria.fastpath_approve: max score where val precision < 10% — agents skipped, auto-approve
criteria.soft_decline: min score where val precision >= 30% — soft challenge user
criteria.review: min score where val precision >= 60% — route to human review
criteria.block: min score where val precision >= 80% — auto-block
criteria.fastpath_block: min score where val precision >= 90% — agents skipped, definite fraud
